items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Yeah, Zeb, Splendid Platt, they all came from down that way.

ctx.x: Did he play up in the country or down in New York?

Yeah, in the country. No, he used to play in brass band. Up there, they had a brass band? Yeah, yeah, one of them in Yolens, Louisiana brass band. So I don't know how my brother started, but he gave me these sticks. So that's how I picked it up myself. So my first plane was, he used to work for Dennis, a Dr. Graw in New Orleans, and he used to go down below the city in Plaquemine Parish, I think you call it that, with a fellow by the name of Till. He used to hire the fellows out of New Orleans and go to play down…

So one time, my brother couldn't get off. Well, excuse me, do you know Zeb's real name, his last name? No, all I knew was he's Zeb. No, I never could think of his last name, Clarence Platt. I believe Professor Minetta, who was here last night, said something like L-E-N-O-I-R.
